Cache the Spotify OAuth token outside the working directory

spotipy's default cache is ./.cache, so every folder sung ran from kept a
refresh token. get_spotify_oauth_creds now defaults the cache to
$SUNG_SPOTIFY_TOKEN_CACHE or ~/.local/share/sung/spotify_token.json; an
explicit cache_handler or cache_path is kept.
